en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, 
(It has been narrated) Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘A time for Salāt of the eclipse among the timing which it eclipses, (be it) at the emergence of the sun, and at its setting’.
And Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is Obligatory’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the time of Salah (prayer) because of eclipse at sunrise and sunset if it can be performed at such time.
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘It is obligatory.’”
